title: Q28 parts a to c: testing the claim

beats.text: Part a. The heat gained by the calorimeter is the calibration factor times the rise: three hundred times three point two zero, which is nine hundred and sixty joules. Two marks.

Part b. Dissolving one mole of X releases twenty-four point zero kilojoules. So the amount of X is zero point nine six zero kilojoules divided by twenty-four point zero kilojoules per mole: zero point zero four zero zero moles. Watch the units: convert joules to kilojoules first.

The mass of X is zero point zero four zero zero moles times eighty point zero grams per mole: three point two zero grams. As a percentage of the four point zero zero gram sample, that's eighty point zero percent. Four marks across those steps.
Part c. Eighty point zero percent is well below the claimed ninety-five point zero percent, so this measurement does not support the claim. One mark.
